div.head: II Cn 48
div.ab: Gif hwa mid wige godcundra gerihta forwyrne, gilde lahslit mid Denum, fullwite mid Englum; oððe geladige [hine]: nime XI ⁊ beo sylf twelfta.
Gif hwa mid wige godcundra gerihta forwyrne, gylde lahslit mid Denum, fulwite mid Englum; oððe geladige hine: nime endlifan ⁊ beo sylf twelfta.
Si quis Dei rectitudines prohibeat, soluat láhslit cum Dacis, plenam wítam cum Anglis, uel se adlegiet: assumat XI et idem sit XIImus.
Gif hwa forwyrne godcunde gerihte. Gyf hwa godcundra rihta mid wige forwyrne, gylde lahslit mid Denum ⁊ fulwite mid Englum, oððe geladige hine—nime XI men ⁊ beo him seolf twelfta.
Gif hwa mid wige godcundra gerihta forwyrne, gilde lahslit mid Denum, fullwite mid Englum; oððe geladige hine: nime XI and beo sylf twelfta.

If anyone refuses to render ecclesiastical dues. If anyone resists by force the payment of ecclesiastical dues, he shall pay lahslit in a Danish district, and the full fine in an English one, or he shall clear himself: he shall select 11 men and shall himself make a twelfth.

If anyone resists the payment of their ecclesiastical dues with violence, he must pay lahslit within the Danelaw and the full penalty among the English; or he must exonerate himself: he must select eleven supporters and himself make the twelfth.

If anyone refuses with force to pay ecclesiastical dues, he is to pay lahslit among the Danes, full fine among the English; or, to clear himself, he is to take eleven [men] and be himself the twelfth.

(Wenn jemand kirchliche Gerechtsame verweigert. B) Wenn einer kirchliche Gerechtsame unter Kampf verweigert, zahle er Rechtsbruchbusse bei den Dänen, volles Strafgeld bei den Engländern, oder schwöre sich rein: wähle sich elf (Männer B) [als Helfer] und sei selbst Zwölfter [im Eide].

(If anyone withholds God's dues. B) If anyone withholds God's dues by force, let him pay lahslit among the Danes, the full fine among the English, or clear himself: let him take eleven (men, B) [as helpers] and be himself the twelfth [in the oath].
div.note: ‘hine’ is written with the abbreviation ·N· in G. Liebermann compares EGu 6.4 f.
From here to 48.3 is taken from “Edward and Guthrum”, 6.4–6.7, but with a significant alteration in 48.1, for the source prescribed the payment of wergild for this offence.
The source said nothing about the method of exculpation.
B adds rubric Gif hwa forwyrne godcunde gerihte hine: ~N~ G XI and: XI men and B
